hash_normalization: UTF-8 file bytes with CRLF replaced by LF; portable across Git checkout line endings

simulator.type: handcrafted condition effects and profile interactions with deterministic MD5-seeded noise
simulator.oracle_scope: entire capped candidate universe before rule filtering

legacy_assistance.status_scope: Curated CSV Stage 2 status stores only the last gate; local artifacts were checked for both rounds.
legacy_assistance.run_success: Legacy execution flag; does not establish successful LLM evaluation.
legacy_assistance.batch_change_limit: Legacy gate checked rank cutoff changes before diversity selection, not an enforced bound on actual batch changes.
legacy_assistance.attribution_limit: The Stage 1 treatment does not isolate the effect of model recommendations from the merged domain heuristics.

historical_model_provenance.verification: All four source results/final_benchmark CSVs exactly match the public snapshot; all 216 matching model-bearing artifacts inspected, including 36 duplicate raw Stage 1 critiques.
historical_model_provenance.unknown_reason: The legacy client logged the requested model alias, not the provider-returned model or backend revision. No inference from current configuration.

current_execution.successful_response: Only supplied model actions, bounded by calibration and actual batch-change constraints.
current_execution.failed_or_unavailable_response: No LLM score changes or candidate rejections; failed summarizer supplies empty recommendations.
current_execution.deterministic_backstop_mode: Removed from execution; historical implementation remains at snapshot_commit.
current_execution.preprocessing_change: Match tBuBrettPhos/t-BuBrettPhos before the shorter BrettPhos substring; historical normalization collapsed these labels.

data.verified_evidence: Precedent records contain patent identifiers and structured reaction conditions; support CSVs contain reaction and condition labels. Repository history provides no canonical upstream dataset or redistribution terms.
loader_transformations: Normalizes ligand/base/solvent labels and derives heuristic features from reaction strings.
Drops precedent rows without a reaction string or at least two recognized condition labels.
Parses precedent yield percentages; uses default 80 C and 10 h for precedent conditions.
Parses support conditions from exp_name; assigns fixed proxy outcome_yield 0.84 to success and 0.18 to failure examples.
